newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt August jobs indicator falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt August jobs indicator falls.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment fell in August to minus 0.418 from minus 0.350 a month earlier, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.
The department said in a statement the latest fall in the indicator suggested jobs growth would remain subdued for some time.
"The leading indicator continued to fall in August following consecutive declines in the previous four months," it said.
"This suggests that employment growth is likely to remain subdued well into 1997."
The indicator combines seven other indicators, including vehicle registrations, housing approvals and official and private sector measures of job vacancies.
It has been shown to lead employment changes consistently over the long term.
